component.name: Glyph - Text Extractor
component.summary: Lightning-fast screen text extractor for Linux

description.p: Glyph - Text Extractor is a lightning-fast screen text extractor for Linux desktops, inspired by PowerToys Text Extractor. It enables you to instantly select any screen region, extract text using optical character recognition, and automatically copy it to your clipboard.

ul.li: Instant Mode A pipeline: crop, preprocess, extract, and copy directly to the system clipboard in milliseconds.
Interactive Mode B editor: review, format, trim whitespace, and join broken lines before copying.
Automatic page segmentation preserving statement breaks and paragraph layout spacing with multi-stage fallback.
Native Wayland and X11 compositor support via XDG Desktop Portal, grim, slurp, maim, or scrot.
Reliable cross-desktop notifications with formatted text escaping and branded application icons.
Local, offline processing with zero telemetry and private temporary file storage.
Lightweight, native GTK4 and Libadwaita user interface following GNOME Human Interface Guidelines.

description.p: Cross-distro RPM compatibility release with openSUSE dependency resolution, dynamic Python runtime detection, and Flathub packaging preparation.

ul.li: Enhanced RPM spec with rich Boolean dependencies resolving python3-Pillow, tesseract-ocr, and libadwaita-1-0 on openSUSE Leap and Tumbleweed
Dynamic Python 3 (>= 3.10) interpreter resolution in RPM and native launchers, preventing missing PIL errors on multi-Python distros
Added graceful runtime dependency validation with distribution-specific package manager instructions
Flathub Flatpak packaging readiness with GNOME 49 runtime and store branding metadata

description.p: Cross-distro polish and packaging stability release for Arch Linux, Fedora, and Debian environments.

ul.li: Interactive and automatic shell PATH configuration ensuring ~/.local/bin is registered across bash and zsh
Arch Linux package dependency alignment adding tesseract-data-eng
Aligned cross-desktop and tiling window manager (Hyprland, Sway) shortcut instructions with v0.2.0 defaults
Verified out-of-the-box compatibility on Fedora 40+ and Arch Linux Wayland environments

description.p: Next-generation OCR engine upgrade with geometry-aware PSM layout detection, edge enhancement, and silent Wayland portal integration.

ul.li: Smart geometry-based PSM layout detection prioritizing single-line (PSM 7) and block (PSM 6) modes for screen clippings
Screen-optimized Tesseract configuration with interword space preservation and explicit 300 DPI neural LSTM heuristics
Unsharp mask edge sharpening for antialiased screen fonts and Otsu binarization fallback for low-contrast text
Multi-pass recognition cascade and TSV structured data extraction with word-level confidence
Fixed D-Bus PermissionStore pre-authorization for silent snapshot capture in GNOME Wayland

description.p: Reliable desktop notifications, statement break OCR preservation, and cross-distro conflict detection.

ul.li: Preserved statement breaks and paragraph layout spacing by defaulting OCR page segmentation mode to auto (PSM 3) with resilient multi-mode fallbacks
Hardened desktop notifications with XML/HTML character escaping and direct absolute icon path resolution across desktop environments
Added cross-distro dual-install collision detection and diagnostic warnings in CLI and installer
Optimized desktop shortcut handler to resolve running executable paths dynamically

description.p: Streamlined capture pipeline, refreshed brand identity, and enhanced GNOME Wayland integration.

ul.li: Eliminated legacy desktop screenshot fallbacks preventing freeze on modern Wayland compositors
Refreshed brand identity with updated master SVG and high-resolution icons (48x48 to 512x512)
Enhanced GNOME desktop launcher integration with instant startup responsiveness
Hardened shortcut registration with absolute binary path resolution
Optimized Linux package installers (.deb, .rpm, portable)

description.p: Branded desktop notifications, documentation updates, and upgrade lifecycle guides.

ul.li: Official Glyph application logo and desktop-entry hint in system notifications
Comprehensive multi-distro upgrade instructions in documentation
Portable tarball archive packaging support

description.p: Cross-desktop global shortcut engine and universal multi-distro packaging.

ul.li: Interactive desktop shortcut configuration with collision detection and conflict resolution
Support for GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, Cinnamon, MATE, Hyprland, Sway, and i3
Official Debian (.deb), Fedora/openSUSE (.rpm), and Arch Linux PKGBUILD packaging
Standalone portable Linux tarball with self-contained launcher
